tariff2026.structure: Domestic metered (servicio medido), billed per bimester per toma: pay cuota minima of the band + (litres above band's lower limit / 1000) x cuota adicional. Subsidy depends on the manzana class (Popular, Baja, Media, Alta).

cuotaFijaTandeoOrNoMeter.note: Applies to domestic tomas in colonias on the annual tandeo list (and unmetered tomas where the colonia is under 70% metered).

tariff2026.warning: Press/calculator summaries giving '$4.22/m3 popular ... $82.40 fixed' do not match the Codigo Fiscal and should not be used.

manzanaClassForColonias.method: Share of records by indice_des in the SACMEX 2019 consumption dataset (same file as above). Classification is per manzana, so a colonia is mixed.

source.title: Consumo de agua (SACMEX), consumo_agua_historico_2019.csv

manzanaClassForColonias.note: Typical class: Polanco = Alta; Condesa = mostly Alta; Roma Norte = mostly Alta with Baja/Media blocks; Roma Sur = split Alta/Baja. 2019 classification; later reclassification not checked.

source.title: Thames Water 2025-26 Annual Performance Report tables, Table 3C lines 3C.10-3C.13

london.scope: Whole Thames Water supply area (London + Thames Valley); London alone not separable.
london.arithmetic: Table stores total minutes lost as Excel day-fractions in thousands of properties: e.g. 31935.079 x 1440 = 45,986,514 property-minutes; / 4,107,209 = 11.20 min (reported 00:11:12); / 91,252 = 504 min = 8.4 h. Shares = properties interrupted / 4,107,209. A property interrupted twice may be counted twice.
london.note: Largest 2025-26 event: 800 mm trunk main burst at Swinford (OX29), 4-6 March 2026, reservoir feeding 45,000 properties; ~7,000 still without water at repair completion (APR 2025-26 p.17).
